name: Lin Chuang
source:
Reserved / Straightforward / Easily Flustered

A quiet boy who keeps his distance from others.

Rinso is not good at pretending. He says what he thinks, even when his words come out too direct, and he often seems cold simply because he does not know how to get close to people.

But behind his awkward silence, there may be a kind of sincerity that is harder to find than any sweet lie.
